keywords: EIP-8141 区块打包与付款方偿付能力
summary: pintail 提交 EIP-8363 Tapered Issuance Burn，用部分销毁验证者奖励的方式修改 ETH 发行曲线，Magicians 讨论帖当天成为热帖。账户侧，两份 EIP-8141 PR 补规范：一份让 FOCIL 对 frame 交易检查验证前缀而不是 nonce 和余额，另一份写明区块构建者必须检查的 gas 预留和付款方偿付能力。EIP-8038 的 `ACCOUNT_WRITE` 定为 9,000 并合并。

items.topic: EIP-8141 补上内存池之外的规则
items.title: EIP-8141：frame 感知的 inclusion list（FOCIL）有效性
items.note: （Marchhill）提交。要求 EIP-7805 的 inclusion list 有效性检查评估 frame 交易的验证前缀，而不是 nonce 和余额，并新增 `MAX_IL_VERIFY_GAS`。
items.note_en: (Marchhill), submitted. It requires EIP-7805 inclusion list validity checks to evaluate a frame transaction's validation prefix instead of its nonce and balance, and adds `MAX_IL_VERIFY_GAS`.

items.topic: EIP-8141 补上内存池之外的规则
items.title: EIP-8141：规定区块打包门槛和付款方偿付能力
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。PR 指出两点目前只是隐含的：区块 gas 预留是 `max_gas`，偿付能力属于 `payer`，而后者只出现在内存池章节，区块构建者并不必遵守；复用现有交易选择路径的实现会因此继承缺陷。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: specify block inclusion gating and payer solvency
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. The PR notes two facts that are only implied today: the block gas reservation is `max_gas`, and solvency belongs to `payer`, which appears only in the Mempool section that a block builder is not required to follow; an implementation reusing its existing transaction selection path inherits the resulting defects.

items.title: donnoh：提议通过携带 STARK 的 frame 交易（8141 + 8288）实现原生 rollup
items.note: 21:16，借注册表让原生 rollup 强制执行遵循 L1 语义的证明，可随 L1 自动升级或固定某个分叉。
items.title_en: donnoh: a proposal for native rollups via STARK-carrying frame transactions (8141 + 8288)
items.note_en: 21:16. With a registry, native rollups can enforce proofs that follow L1 semantics and either upgrade automatically with L1 or pin a specific fork.

items.title: EIP-2780：修订 COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS 和 ACCOUNT_WRITE 取值
items.note: （misilva73）合并。PR 说明在 EIP-8038 中把 `COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS` 定为 2,100（与现值相同），`ACCOUNT_WRITE` 定为 9,000，并重新计算 `CREATE_ACCESS`、`STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND`、`ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST`。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: revise COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS and ACCOUNT_WRITE values
items.note_en: (misilva73), merged. Per the PR, EIP-8038 sets `COLD_STORAGE_ACCESS` to 2,100 (unchanged from today) and `ACCOUNT_WRITE` to 9,000, and recomputes `CREATE_ACCESS`, `STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND` and `ACCESS_LIST_STORAGE_KEY_COST`.

items.title: EIP-2780：对齐运行时收费和参考用例
items.note: （spencer-tb）提交。原文对自转账免除全部接收方运行时收费，与 EIP 自己的“EIP-7702 委托账户向自己转 ETH”参考行和各实现不一致，各实现都收取委托目标的访问费。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: align runtime charging and reference cases
items.note_en: (spencer-tb), submitted. The text exempted self-transfers from all runtime recipient charges, contradicting the EIP's own "ETH transfer to self, sender 7702 delegated" reference row and the implementations, which all charge the delegation-target access.

items.title: Magicians：EIP-8363 Tapered Issuance Burn
items.note: 16:30（pintail），对应 PR 12081。通过部分销毁验证者奖励修改发行曲线，按职责销毁的设计来自 Anders Elowsson。据 Ethereal news #34，净质押收益在质押率 50% 时线性降到零，升级后 18 个月逐步生效。
items.note_en: 16:30 (pintail), with PR 12081. It modifies the issuance curve by partly burning validator rewards, with the per-duty burn design credited to Anders Elowsson. Per Ethereal news #34, net staking yield tapers linearly to zero at a 50% staking ratio, phased in over 18 months after the upgrade.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 block inclusion and payer solvency
summary_en: pintail submitted EIP-8363 Tapered Issuance Burn, which changes the ETH issuance curve by partly burning validator rewards, and its Magicians thread became the day's hot topic. On accounts, two EIP-8141 PRs filled gaps in the spec: one makes FOCIL check a frame transaction's validation prefix instead of its nonce and balance, and the other spells out the gas reservation and payer solvency a block builder must check. EIP-8038's `ACCOUNT_WRITE` was set to 9,000 and merged.
